body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0080 {
  meta:
    author = "DaC"
    description = "Sysmon: File created in Startup folder (persistence) - Detects creation of executable/script content in Startup folders which is a common persistence technique."
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0080"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1547.001"

  events:
    ($e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION")
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "11"
    $e.target.file.full_path = /\\(programdata|users)\\.*\\start menu\\programs\\startup\\/ nocase
    $e.target.file.full_path = /\.(exe|dll|ps1|vbs|js|lnk|bat|cmd)$/ nocase
    $name = $e.principal.hostname
    $name_ = $e.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $name, $name_ over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $files = array_distinct($e.target.file.full_path)
    $images = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.full_path)

  condition:
    $e
}
